title: [v3-4-test] Show source code lines in task log tracebacks (#75100)
body:
structlog's ExceptionDictTransformer only records each frame's filename,
line number and function name, so tracebacks in task logs (which are always
written as JSON) no longer showed the line of code that was running. Add it
via linecache, as the stdlib traceback module does, and show it under each
frame in the UI log view.
(cherry picked from commit 79d3afc82b5f9873cffcb9b6f2e8a992fe1c1d52)

Co-authored-by: Souradeep Biswas <30365437+souradeep07@users.noreply.github.com>
closes: #55910

files.patch:
@@ -20,6 +20,7 @@
 import codecs
 import io
 import itertools
+import linecache
 import logging
 import os
 import re
@@ -363,6 +364,16 @@ def safe_enc_hook(obj):
     return safe_enc_hook
 
 
+def _add_source_lines(stacks: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Add each frame's source code ``line``, which structlog's ``ExceptionDictTransformer`` omits."""
+    for stack in stacks:
+        for frame in stack["frames"]:
+            linecache.checkcache(frame["filename"])
+            if line := linecache.getline(frame["filename"], frame["lineno"]).strip():
+                frame["line"] = line
+    return stacks
+
+
 @cache
 def structlog_processors(
     json_output: bool,
@@ -436,7 +447,9 @@ def structlog_processors(
             use_rich=False, show_locals=False, suppress=suppress
         )
 
-        dict_tracebacks = structlog.processors.ExceptionRenderer(dict_exc_formatter)
+        dict_tracebacks = structlog.processors.ExceptionRenderer(
+            lambda exc_info: _add_source_lines(dict_exc_formatter(exc_info))
+        )
 
         import msgspec
